title: Biased mean of a sign monomial
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $p\in[0,1]$, and let $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. Under the product distribution of independent signs for which the probability of $-1$ is $p$, the mean of the sign monomial indexed by $S$ is $(1-2p)^{|S|}$.
hypotheses_covered: $S$ is a subset of the $n$ coordinates
